passages.context: The six sections were inspected together. The catechesis begins from the institution narrative, cites John 6:53 while rejecting carnal misunderstanding, and directs initiates to judge the Eucharistic Body and Blood by Christ's declaration rather than taste. Verification is of Gifford's English witness; authorship of the mystagogical lectures remains disputed and the Greek was not collated.
